blocks.text: To'g'ri va noto'g'ri fe'llar: V1, V2, V3

Ingliz tilidagi har bir fe'lning uchta asosiy shakli bor: **V1** — asosiy shakl (work, go), **V2** — o'tgan zamon shakli (worked, went) va **V3** — uchinchi shakl, past participle (worked, gone). O'zbek tilida barcha fe'llar bir xil qoida bilan o'zgaradi: bor → bor**di** → bor**gan**, ishla → ishla**di** → ishla**gan**. Ingliz tilida esa fe'llar ikki turga bo'linadi: **to'g'ri fe'llar** (regular) V2 va V3 ni qoida bo'yicha — `-ed` qo'shib hosil qiladi; **noto'g'ri fe'llar** (irregular) esa o'z shakllariga ega, ularni yod olish kerak. Noto'g'ri fe'llar ko'p emas (200 ga yaqin), lekin aynan ular eng ko'p ishlatiladi: go, see, make, take, get, have, be.

rows: Present Simple; do / does / did dan keyin; to dan keyin
have / has dan keyin (Present Perfect); be dan keyin (majhul nisbat)

blocks.text: Fe'llarning ko'pchiligi to'g'ri: V2 va V3 bir xil va `-ed` bilan tugaydi: work – work**ed** – work**ed**, visit – visit**ed** – visit**ed**. Lug'atda «irregular» deb belgilanmagan fe'l — to'g'ri fe'l. Faqat imloga e'tibor bering: ba'zi so'zlarda `-ed` qo'shilganda oxirgi harf o'zgaradi yoki ikkilanadi.

rows: qisqa so'z, bitta unli + bitta undosh: undosh ikkilanadi

blocks.text: `-w`, `-x` va `-y` hech qachon ikkilanmaydi: snow → snow**ed**, fix → fix**ed**, play → play**ed**. Ikki bo'g'inli so'zlarda qoida murakkabroq (visit → visit**ed**, lekin prefer → prefe**rred**) — batafsil 120-darsda.

Noto'g'ri fe'llarda V2 va V3 ni qoida bilan topib bo'lmaydi: buy → **bought** («buyed» emas), go → **went** («goed» emas). Ularni o'rganishni yengillashtirish uchun guruhlarga bo'lish mumkin. Quyida eng ko'p uchraydiganlari; to'liq ro'yxat — 117-darsda (alifbo tartibida) va 118-darsda (guruhlab). Eng katta guruh — **V2 va V3 bir xil**:
Ikkinchi guruh — **uchala shakli har xil**. Aynan shu fe'llarda V2 va V3 eng ko'p adashtiriladi:
Yana ikki kichik guruh: **uchala shakli bir xil** (cut, put, cost, hit, shut) va **V1 bilan V3 bir xil** (come, become, run).

items.text: I **bought** a new phone last week.
We **went** to the mountains on Sunday.

blocks.text: V2 va V3 ning vazifasi turlicha. **V2** faqat bitta joyda — Past Simple'ning darak gapida: I **went**, she **saw** (→ 11-dars). **V3** esa yordamchi fe'ldan keyin keladi: have / has dan keyin — Present Perfect (I've **gone**, she has **seen**, → 15-dars), be dan keyin — majhul nisbat (it was **written**, → 21-dars). Past Simple'ning inkor va so'rog'ida esa did dan keyin — **V1**: Did you **go**? (→ 23-dars). To'g'ri fe'llarda V2 = V3 bo'lgani uchun bu farq sezilmaydi; noto'g'ri fe'llarda esa aynan shu yerda xato qilinadi.

items.text: Bekzod **has gone** to Moscow, so he isn't here.
items.translation: Bekzod Moskvaga **ketgan**, shuning uchun u bu yerda yo'q.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I goed.» → **I went.**; «He buyed it.» → **He bought it.**; «I have saw.» → **I have seen.**; «She has went.» → **She has gone.**; «It was wrote.» → **It was written.**; «Did you went?» → **Did you go?**; imloda: «studyed» → **studied**, «stoped» → **stopped**, «I planed» → **I planned** (planed — boshqa so'z).

Noto'g'ri fe'llarni uchtalik zanjir qilib, ovoz chiqarib yod oling: go – went – gone, see – saw – seen. O'xshashlarini birga o'rganing: buy – bought, bring – brought, think – thought, teach – taught, catch – caught (`-ought` / `-aught`); send – sent, spend – spent, build – built (`-d` → `-t`); sleep – slept, keep – kept, feel – felt (`ee` → `e` + `-t`). Har kuni 5 ta fe'l va har biri bilan bitta o'z gapingiz — eng yaxshi usul.

British va American English farqi: Britaniyada travel**led**, cancel**led**, Amerikada traveled, canceled. Britaniyada learn**t** / learned, spel**t** / spelled ikkalasi ham ishlatiladi. get ning V3 shakli Britaniyada **got** (I've got), Amerikada ko'pincha gotten. Bizning kitob — British English.

examples.title: Regular verbs: **-ed** in the past
examples.description: To'g'ri fe'llarning Past Simple shakli — V1 + `-ed` (yoki `-e` dan keyin `-d`): clean → **cleaned**, live → **lived**. O'zbekchada: «-di».

sentences.text: Yesterday I **cleaned** the whole flat and **washed** the car.
sentences.translation: Kecha butun kvartirani **tozaladim** va mashinani **yuvdim**.

sentences.text: We **watched** an old film on TV last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun televizorda eski film **ko'rdik**.

sentences.text: My grandfather **worked** at the same factory for forty years.
sentences.translation: Bobom bitta zavodda qirq yil **ishlagan**.

sentences.text: Emma **lived** in Oxford before she **moved** to London.
sentences.translation: Emma Londonga **ko'chib o'tishidan** oldin Oksfordda **yashagan**.

sentences.text: The match **started** late because of the rain.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir tufayli o'yin kech **boshlandi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **invited** all his classmates to his birthday party.
sentences.translation: Aziz tug'ilgan kuniga barcha sinfdoshlarini **taklif qildi**.

sentences.text: When the teacher **asked** a question, nobody **answered**.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi savol **berganda**, hech kim **javob bermadi**.

sentences.text: I **phoned** you three times this morning! Where were you?
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab sizga uch marta **qo'ng'iroq qildim**! Qayerda edingiz?

sentences.text: Last summer my cousins **visited** us from Bukhara and **stayed** for a week.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yozda buxorolik amakivachchalarim bizga **mehmonga kelishdi** va bir hafta **qolishdi**.

sentences.text: The shop assistant **smiled** and **helped** me to find the right size.
sentences.translation: Sotuvchi **jilmaydi** va to'g'ri o'lchamni topishimga **yordam berdi**.

examples.title: Spelling: stud**ied**, sto**pped**, trave**lled**
examples.description: `-ed` imlosi: undosh + `-y` → `-ied` (study → **studied**); qisqa so'zda bitta unli + bitta undosh → undosh ikkilanadi (stop → **stopped**); British English'da `-l` ham ikkilanadi (travel → **travelled**).

sentences.text: Bekzod **studied** economics at university in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Bekzod Toshkentdagi universitetda iqtisodiyotni **o'qigan**.

sentences.text: The bus **stopped** suddenly, and I **dropped** my coffee.
sentences.translation: Avtobus to'satdan **to'xtadi**, men esa qahvamni **tushirib yubordim**.

sentences.text: We **planned** our trip to Samarkand very carefully.
sentences.translation: Samarqandga safarimizni juda puxta **rejalashtirdik**.

sentences.text: I **tried** to call you, but your phone was off.
sentences.translation: Sizga qo'ng'iroq qilishga **harakat qildim**, lekin telefoningiz o'chiq edi.

sentences.text: Last year Sarah and James **travelled** across Central Asia by train.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili Sara va Jeyms Markaziy Osiyo bo'ylab poyezdda **sayohat qilishdi**.

sentences.text: Our flight was **cancelled**, so we **stayed** another night in the hotel.
sentences.translation: Reysimiz **bekor qilindi**, shuning uchun mehmonxonada yana bir kecha **qoldik**.

sentences.text: My little brother **cried** when his balloon flew away.
sentences.translation: Shari uchib ketganda ukam **yig'ladi**.

sentences.text: Madina **carried** the heavy boxes upstairs on her own.
sentences.translation: Madina og'ir qutilarni yuqoriga yolg'iz o'zi **ko'tarib chiqdi**.

sentences.text: The children **hurried** home because it **started** to snow.
sentences.translation: Qor yog'a **boshlagani** uchun bolalar uyga **shoshildi**.

sentences.text: We **enjoyed** the concert so much that we **clapped** for ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Konsert bizga shunchalik **yoqdiki**, o'n daqiqa **qarsak chaldik**.

examples.title: Regular verbs: V2 = V3
examples.description: To'g'ri fe'llarda V2 va V3 bir xil (`-ed`): Past Simple'da ham (She **cooked** dinner), Present Perfect va majhul nisbatda ham (She **has cooked**, It **was painted**).

sentences.text: Dilnoza **cooked** dinner for the whole family last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun Dilnoza butun oila uchun kechki ovqat **pishirdi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **has cooked** plov, and it smells wonderful.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza palov **pishiribdi**, hidi ajoyib.

sentences.text: We **painted** the bedroom blue last weekend.
sentences.translation: O'tgan dam olish kunlari yotoqxonani ko'k rangga **bo'yadik**.

sentences.text: The bedroom **was painted** by my father and me.
sentences.translation: Yotoqxonani otam bilan men **bo'yadik**.

sentences.text: **Have** you ever **visited** Khiva? — Yes, I **visited** it in 2019.
sentences.translation: Hech Xivada **bo'lganmisiz**? — Ha, 2019-yilda **borganman**.

sentences.text: The new rules **were explained** at the meeting on Monday.
sentences.translation: Yangi qoidalar dushanba kungi majlisda **tushuntirildi**.

sentences.text: Tom **has** already **booked** a table for Friday.
sentences.translation: Tom juma kuniga allaqachon stol **band qilib qo'ydi**.

sentences.text: The windows **haven't been cleaned** for months.
sentences.translation: Derazalar bir necha oydan beri **tozalanmagan**.

sentences.text: My parents **moved** here in 1990, and they**'ve lived** in this house since then.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam bu yerga 1990-yilda **ko'chib kelishgan** va o'shandan beri shu uyda **yashashadi**.

sentences.text: Your parcel **arrived** this morning, and I**'ve placed** it on your desk.
sentences.translation: Posilkangiz bugun ertalab **keldi**, uni stolingizga **qo'ydim**.

examples.title: Irregular: V2 = V3 (**bought**, **made**, **left**)
examples.description: Ko'p noto'g'ri fe'llarda V2 va V3 bir xil, lekin `-ed` emas: buy – **bought** – **bought**, make – **made** – **made**, leave – **left** – **left**.

sentences.text: I **bought** these shoes in a small shop in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Bu poyabzalni Manchesterdagi kichik do'kondan **sotib oldim**.

sentences.text: **Have** you ever **made** sumalak? It takes all night!
sentences.translation: Hech sumalak **pishirganmisiz**? U tun bo'yi pishadi!

sentences.text: Bekzod **left** his phone in a taxi, but the driver **brought** it back.
sentences.translation: Bekzod telefonini taksida **qoldirib ketdi**, lekin haydovchi uni **olib kelib berdi**.

sentences.text: We **met** in 2015, at a friend's wedding in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Biz 2015-yilda Samarqandda bir do'stimizning to'yida **tanishganmiz**.

sentences.text: My grandmother **taught** English at a village school for thirty years.
sentences.translation: Buvim qishloq maktabida o'ttiz yil ingliz tilidan **dars bergan**.

sentences.text: I **haven't heard** from Sarah since she **sent** me that postcard from Spain.
sentences.translation: Sara menga Ispaniyadan o'sha otkritkani **yuborganidan** beri undan **xabar yo'q**.

sentences.text: The house **was built** in 1950 and **sold** to my grandfather in 1960.
sentences.translation: Uy 1950-yilda **qurilgan** va 1960-yilda bobomga **sotilgan**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **found** your glasses? — Yes, they were in the fridge!
sentences.translation: Ko'zoynagingizni **topdingizmi**? — Ha, muzlatgichda ekan!

sentences.text: Last night I **slept** badly because I **felt** ill.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechasi yomon **uxladim**, chunki **betob edim**.

sentences.text: James **told** us a funny story about the time he **got** lost in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Jeyms bizga Buxoroda **adashib qolgani** haqida kulgili voqeani **aytib berdi**.

examples.title: Irregular: go – **went** – **gone**
examples.description: Ba'zi noto'g'ri fe'llarning uchala shakli ham har xil: go – **went** – **gone**, see – **saw** – **seen**, write – **wrote** – **written**. Aynan shu fe'llarda V2 va V3 ko'p adashtiriladi.

sentences.text: We **went** to Chimgan last weekend, and the children loved it.
sentences.translation: O'tgan dam olish kunlari Chimyonga **bordik**, bolalarga juda yoqdi.

sentences.text: Dad isn't here — he**'s gone** to the market.
sentences.translation: Dadam yo'q — bozorga **ketgan**.

sentences.text: I **saw** your brother with a big bunch of flowers near the metro.
sentences.translation: Akangizni metro yonida katta guldasta bilan **ko'rdim**.

sentences.text: **Have** you **seen** the new cartoon at the cinema yet?
sentences.translation: Kinoteatrdagi yangi multfilmni **ko'rdingizmi**?

sentences.text: Abdulla Qodiriy **wrote** his most famous novel in the 1920s.
sentences.translation: Abdulla Qodiriy eng mashhur romanini 1920-yillarda **yozgan**.

sentences.text: This letter **was written** in English, so Madina translated it for us.
sentences.translation: Bu xat ingliz tilida **yozilgan**, shuning uchun Madina uni biz uchun tarjima qildi.

sentences.text: Somebody **has taken** my umbrella from the office!
sentences.translation: Kimdir ofisdan soyabonimni **olib ketibdi**!

sentences.text: I **ate** too much at the wedding, and now I feel terrible.
sentences.translation: To'yda juda ko'p **yeb qo'ydim**, endi o'zimni yomon his qilyapman.

sentences.text: Sorry, I**'ve forgotten** your name again.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, ismingizni yana **unutib qo'ydim**.

sentences.text: Emma **drove** from London to Edinburgh in one day — she **has** never **driven** so far before.
sentences.translation: Emma Londondan Edinburgga bir kunda **mashinada bordi** — u ilgari hech qachon bunchalik uzoqqa **mashina haydamagan**.

examples.title: **cut** – **cut** – **cut**; come – **came** – **come**
examples.description: Ba'zi fe'llarda uchala shakl bir xil: cut, put, cost, hit, shut. Boshqalarida V1 va V3 bir xil: come – **came** – **come**, become – **became** – **become**, run – **ran** – **run**.

sentences.text: Yesterday I **cut** my finger while I was making a salad.
sentences.translation: Kecha salat qilayotganimda barmog'imni **kesib oldim**.

sentences.text: Where **have** you **put** the car keys? — On the shelf.
sentences.translation: Mashina kalitlarini qayerga **qo'ydingiz**? — Javonga.

sentences.text: My new phone **cost** a lot, but it's worth it.
sentences.translation: Yangi telefonim ancha **qimmat turdi**, lekin bunga arziydi.

sentences.text: The ball **hit** the window, but luckily it didn't break.
sentences.translation: To'p derazaga **tegdi**, lekin baxtga sinmadi.

sentences.text: Somebody **has shut** the door, and I haven't got my key!
sentences.translation: Kimdir eshikni **yopib qo'yibdi**, kalitim esa yo'q!

sentences.text: Aziz **came** home late last night and **went** straight to bed.
sentences.translation: Aziz kecha uyga kech **keldi** va to'g'ri borib **yotdi**.

sentences.text: Our guests **have come** from Kazakhstan, so we're cooking something special.
sentences.translation: Mehmonlarimiz Qozog'istondan **kelishgan**, shuning uchun alohida bir taom tayyorlayapmiz.

sentences.text: After university, Madina **became** a doctor like her mother.
sentences.translation: Universitetdan keyin Madina onasi kabi shifokor **bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Tashkent **has become** a very big city in the last twenty years.
sentences.translation: So'nggi yigirma yilda Toshkent juda katta shaharga **aylandi**.

sentences.text: I **ran** five kilometres this morning — I**'ve** never **run** that far before!
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab besh kilometr **yugurdim** — ilgari hech qachon bunchalik uzoq **yugurmaganman**!

examples.title: V2 or V3? Past simple and present perfect
examples.description: V2 — faqat Past Simple darak gapida. V3 — have / has dan keyin (Present Perfect) va be dan keyin (majhul nisbat). did dan keyin esa — V1: **Did** you **see** ...? — Yes, I **saw** ...

sentences.text: **Did** you **see** the fireworks on Independence Day? — Yes, I **saw** them from our balcony.
sentences.translation: Mustaqillik kunidagi mushakbozlikni **ko'rdingizmi**? — Ha, balkonimizdan **ko'rdim**.

sentences.text: **Have** you ever **eaten** horse meat? — Yes, I **ate** it at a wedding in Jizzakh.
sentences.translation: Hech ot go'shti **yeganmisiz**? — Ha, Jizzaxdagi bir to'yda **yeganman**.

sentences.text: I **wrote** to the manager last week, but he **hasn't written** back yet.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta menejerga **yozdim**, lekin u hali javob **yozmadi**.

sentences.text: Where **did** you **buy** this carpet? — We **bought** it in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Bu gilamni qayerdan **sotib oldingiz**? — Buxorodan **oldik**.

sentences.text: The bridge **was built** in the 1960s; the old one **fell** down in an earthquake.
sentences.translation: Ko'prik 1960-yillarda **qurilgan**, eskisi zilzilada **qulab tushgan**.

sentences.text: Sarah **has gone** to Wales for the weekend; she **took** the early train.
sentences.translation: Sara dam olish kunlari uchun Uelsga **ketgan**; u erta tongdagi poyezdga **chiqdi**.

sentences.text: Tom **broke** his arm last winter, and he **hasn't played** football since.
sentences.translation: Tom o'tgan qishda qo'lini **sindirdi** va o'shandan beri futbol **o'ynamadi**.

sentences.text: When **did** your cousins **arrive**? — They **came** on Monday, and they've already **gone** home.
sentences.translation: Amakivachchalaringiz qachon **kelishdi**? — Dushanba kuni **kelishdi**, allaqachon uylariga **ketib ham qolishdi**.

sentences.text: **Has** anyone **taken** my pen? — Yes, sorry, I **took** it by mistake.
sentences.translation: Kimdir ruchkamni **oldimi**? — Ha, kechirasiz, adashib men **oldim**.

sentences.text: My parents **gave** me a bike for my birthday, and I**'ve ridden** it every day since.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam tug'ilgan kunimga velosiped **sovg'a qilishdi**, o'shandan beri har kuni uni **minib yuraman**.

examples.title: Dialogue: back from holiday
examples.description: Dialog: Dilnoza ta'tildan qaytdi. To'g'ri va noto'g'ri fe'llarning V2 va V3 shakllari aralash: Past Simple, Present Perfect va majhul nisbatda.

sentences.text: — Welcome back, Dilnoza! Where **did** you **go** this time?
sentences.translation: — Xush kelibsiz, Dilnoza! Bu safar qayerga **bordingiz**?

sentences.text: — We **flew** to London and then **travelled** around England by train.
sentences.translation: — Londonga samolyotda **uchdik**, keyin Angliya bo'ylab poyezdda **sayohat qildik**.

sentences.text: — Lucky you! I**'ve** never **been** to England. What **did** you **see** there?
sentences.translation: — Omadingiz bor ekan! Men Angliyada hech **bo'lmaganman**. U yerda nimalarni **ko'rdingiz**?

sentences.text: — We **visited** Oxford and **saw** the castle at Windsor.
sentences.translation: — Oksfordga **bordik** va Vindzordagi qasrni **ko'rdik**.

sentences.text: — **Did** you **try** fish and chips?
sentences.translation: — Baliq bilan kartoshka frini **tatib ko'rdingizmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I **ate** it twice, but I **missed** our plov every day!
sentences.translation: — Ha, ikki marta **yedim**, lekin har kuni palovimizni **sog'indim**!

sentences.text: — **Have** you **brought** any photos? I want to see everything.
sentences.translation: — Suratlar **olib keldingizmi**? Hammasini ko'rgim kelyapti.

sentences.text: — Of course! I**'ve** already **put** them all on my laptop.
sentences.translation: — Albatta! Hammasini allaqachon noutbukimga **joylab qo'ydim**.

sentences.text: — Great. And **did** you **buy** me a present, by any chance?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Aytgancha, menga sovg'a **oldingizmi**?

sentences.text: — I **chose** a mug with a red bus on it — it **was made** in London!
sentences.translation: — Ustida qizil avtobus rasmi bor krujka **tanladim** — u Londonda **yasalgan**!
